verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents first-party bulk operations: granting share awards in bulk, and creating, signing and sharing contracts in a few clicks (ledgy-docs-12, ledgy-docs-10). These are UI workflows, though. The documented API only offers read operations (companyCaptable, companyTransactions) with paging and delta retrieval (ledgy-docs-30), and no OpenAPI spec was found (ledgy-probe-2), so programmatic bulk operations for an AI-native user are not evidenced. Missing for 10: programmatic/API bulk write or batch endpoints, detail on bulk scope and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
